_comment: Contract between the backend (declares these to Gemini) and the app (executes them with the Dart finance engine). Changing a name or parameter requires updating both sides; tests on both sides read this file.

functions.name: get_health_report
functions.description: The user's financial health: score out of 100 with its parts, monthly surplus, savings rate, emergency fund target/gap/months covered, EMI-to-income ratio, net worth, and the top action items. Use for any question about how the user is doing overall.

functions.name: get_assumptions
functions.description: The planning assumptions currently used for every calculation (inflation, illustrative returns per asset class, SIP step-up, emergency fund months, independence corpus multiple), and which ones the user changed from the defaults.

functions.name: plan_goal
functions.description: Plan a goal priced in today's rupees: inflation-adjusted future cost, illustrative asset mix and return for the horizon and the user's risk profile, monthly SIP needed (flat and with yearly step-up), feasibility against the user's monthly surplus, and the step-by-step math.

years.description: Years from now until the money is needed.

already_saved.description: Rupees already set aside for this goal. Default 0.

functions.name: plan_independence
functions.description: Financial independence / retirement plan at a target age: corpus needed from inflated expenses times the corpus multiple, existing investments counted, monthly SIP needed (flat and step-up), feasibility and the math. Use for 'when can I retire' or 'what if I retire at X' questions.

target_age.description: Age at which work becomes optional. Must be above the user's current age.

functions.name: suggest_allocation
functions.description: Illustrative equity / debt / gold / cash split (percentages) for a time horizon and the user's risk profile, with the reasons. Categories only, never specific funds.

horizon_years.description: Years until the money is needed.

functions.name: sip_projection
functions.description: Illustrative future value of a monthly SIP over a number of years, using the return of the illustrative mix for that horizon and the user's risk profile. Also shows the value in today's money after inflation.

annual_step_up.description: Yearly SIP increase as a fraction (0.1 = 10%). Omit to use the user's assumption.

functions.name: loan_payoff
functions.description: Months to repay a loan and total interest left at a given EMI and annual rate; also the effect of paying an extra amount each month.

annual_rate.description: Annual interest rate as a fraction (0.09 = 9%).

extra_monthly.description: Optional extra payment each month, rupees.
